## About the Programme

As Large Language Models become central to research, teaching and industry, using them ethically, transparently and securely is essential. This AICTE-ATAL sponsored programme equips participants with the principles, frameworks and practical skills of responsible AI governance through expert lectures, hands-on sessions, article discussions and an industrial visit to DRDO, Hyderabad.

## Objectives

- Understand the principles and frameworks of responsible AI governance for LLMs
- Explore ethical, transparent, secure and trustworthy use of LLMs in research and industry
- Develop practical skills for managing AI risks: bias, privacy, hallucination, security and data protection
- Design and implement responsible, compliant, industry-ready LLM applications through hands-on sessions and case studies

## Outcomes

- Practical knowledge of responsible AI governance
- Hands-on experience with LLMs, bias detection and XAI tools (SHAP, LIME)
- Ability to identify AI risks and ensure ethical, secure AI use
- Ability to develop responsible LLM-based solutions for research and industry

## Resource Persons

## Who Can Attend

- Faculty members of AICTE-approved institutions
- Research scholars
- Persons working in R&D organizations
- Industry persons and PG students

## Registration & Facilities

- No registration fee
- Lunch will be provided
- Limited accommodation on prior request
- Rs. 1200/- travel reimbursement for external participants travelling more than 20 km one side with at least 90% attendance
- Selection as per AICTE-ATAL guidelines, first come first served; limited to 50 participants

## Certificate Criteria

- Minimum 80% attendance
- Minimum 70% marks in the test at the end of the programme
- 2-page article summary (team or individual)
- Report/outcome of the industrial visit (team), presented at the last session
